disallowedWork: No arbitrary-cohort read-tracking architecture, second state/transaction/graph authority, serialized functions, generic update granting verified operation authority, or arbitrary browser source execution.

goal: Execute the user-approved 28-slice authoring integration proposal through one preserved supply-tax preview and stop at the mandatory authoring/API and visual checkpoint.
commitCadence: Commit implementation tests and completed Theseus evidence after every independently reversible verified slice; checkpoint approved planning changes before implementation.
stopConditions: Stop on absent approval, unresolved semantic authority, failed preserved law not repairable within the slice, required numerical budget increase, unrelated worktree overlap, or scope expansion.
Stop early for HUMAN_CHECKPOINT if a new subjective visual treatment or choreography decision is required; preserve current canonical supply-tax phases and paint ownership.
Always stop after s28 at HUMAN_CHECKPOINT for authoring/API and visual review. Public promotion requires separately approved structural-equation pressure; no generalization slices are included.

Each slice is one reversible commit; isolated host/adapters remain removable without rolling back semantic models. Target at least 50 percent measured orchestration reduction with helper cost disclosed.
